card.name: Second digit of years and dates
card.fires_on: A single digit that starts the last two digits of a year in a year range, or the day number in a date. It fires after a hyphen or slash following a year, or after a month name.

modes.label: End of year range
modes.description: The first digit of the second year after a dash or slash in a range of years.

modes.label: Day in a date
modes.description: The digit of a day number after a month or after a month and slash.

card.plain: It marks a digit inside a year range or a calendar date, such as the 3 in 12/30/2011 or the 4 in 1903-04.
